description: File your operator's control-baseline attestation — the counterpart to counterparty_control_baseline. That tool asks what controls the OTHER side runs; this one publishes what YOUR side runs, so payers can see it before settling with you. No account, no key, one call. Gaps are allowed: answer false where a control is not in place and describe the plan in gapPlan. Get the control ids from baseline_controls first. Only file for a party you are actually authorised to speak for.

agentId.description: If this party already has an agent registered with OceanAlt, link the attestation to it.

answers.description: Map of control id to boolean, e.g. {"ACB-1.1": true, "ACB-2.1": false}. Ids come from baseline_controls.

entity.description: The accountable party's legal or commonly-used name. This is who the attestation is about, not your agent's name.

gapPlan.description: For controls answered false: how and when you plan to close them.

name: attest_control_baseline
title: File your own control-baseline attestation (free)
